rule.declared: 2026-10-12, after the case-list hash pin and before any detector alert was computed on any case or control
rule.order: sha256(seed|market_id) ascending; first 5 accepted per group
rule.pool: Gamma closed binary markets closing within +/-15 d of the case news time, same fee_category and same history_backfill.liquidity_band (lifetime volume) as the case's primary market; catalogue and Maduro condition_ids/events and the case's own event excluded
rule.price_band: band of |p(tau-72h) - 0.5| (bands 0.05/0.20/0.45) equals the case's band of |p(news-72h) - 0.5|
rule.quiet_move: token-0 price series (10 min) over [close-15d, close] has a point s with |p(s) - p(s-24h)| >= 0.10; tau = the first such s (the move's own time)
rule.quiet_nomove: no such point over [close-15d, close]; tau = close - 1 d
rule.relaxation: none; a shortfall below 5 is recorded, never filled by loosening the rule
